en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1358 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar reported from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:

"If you fear experiencing a state of janabah (ritual impurity) during sleep, say in your bed:
'O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge with You from experiencing a wet dream, from evil dreams, and from being manipulated by Shaytan (the devil) in wakefulness and in sleep.'"
